props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `validate`: Validates all fields when called. Optionally pass a field name to validate a single field.

props.name: errors
props.description: Validation errors returned externally, typically after submission by a server or a form action. This should be an object where keys correspond to the `name` attribute on `<Field.Root>`, and values correspond to error(s) related to that field.

props.name: onFormSubmit
props.type: (formValues: Record<string, any>, eventDetails: { reason: 'none'; event: Event; }) => void
props.description: Event handler called when the form is submitted. `preventDefault()` is called on the native submit event when used.

props.name: validationMode
props.description: Determines when the form should be validated. The `validationMode` prop on `<Field.Root>` takes precedence over this. - `onSubmit` (default): validates the field when the form is submitted, afterwards fields will re-validate on change. - `onBlur`: validates a field when it loses focus. - `onChange`: validates the field on every change to its value.
